findings.title: Dangerous permission: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
findings.fix: Remove the permission if the app does not need it; if it does, request it at runtime and explain why.

findings.fix: Remove the permission if the app does not need it; if it does, request it at runtime and explain why.

findings.title: Exported activity: .MainActivity
findings.evidence: android:exported=true. No android:permission — any app on the device can reach it.
findings.fix: Set android:exported=false if no other app needs it, or protect it with android:permission so only chosen apps can reach it.

findings.title: Exported activity: .ShareActivity
findings.evidence: intent-filter present, android:exported not set to false. No android:permission — any app on the device can reach it.
findings.fix: Set android:exported=false if no other app needs it, or protect it with android:permission so only chosen apps can reach it.

findings.title: Exported receiver: .BootReceiver
findings.fix: Keep the android:permission guard, and check the guarded permission is not itself granted to untrusted apps.

findings.title: Application is debuggable
findings.fix: Set android:debuggable=false in the release build (or remove the attribute — release builds default to false).

findings.title: Application allows backup
findings.evidence: android:allowBackup=true in <application> — app data can be pulled off with 'adb backup'.
findings.fix: Set android:allowBackup=false unless backup is a feature users need.

findings.title: Old target SDK: 28
findings.evidence: android:targetSdkVersion=28 (Android 11 is API 30) — the app misses newer platform protections.
findings.fix: Raise android:targetSdkVersion to a current API level.

findings.title: Google API key in classes.dex
findings.fix: Move the secret out of the app — use a server-side proxy, the Android Keystore, or a secrets manager; never ship keys in the APK.

findings.title: AWS access key in classes.dex
findings.fix: Move the secret out of the app — use a server-side proxy, the Android Keystore, or a secrets manager; never ship keys in the APK.

findings.title: Password assignment in classes.dex
findings.fix: Move the secret out of the app — use a server-side proxy, the Android Keystore, or a secrets manager; never ship keys in the APK.

findings.title: Private URL in classes.dex
findings.fix: Move the secret out of the app — use a server-side proxy, the Android Keystore, or a secrets manager; never ship keys in the APK.

findings.title: API key assignment in resources.arsc
findings.fix: Move the secret out of the app — use a server-side proxy, the Android Keystore, or a secrets manager; never ship keys in the APK.

findings.title: Unprotected deep link: labapp://
findings.evidence: Exported activity .ShareActivity handles scheme 'labapp://' (host share) — any app on the device can open it, with no permission check.
findings.fix: Protect the activity with android:permission, verify the link (App Links with assetlinks.json) instead of a bare custom scheme, or set android:exported=false.

findings.title: Cleartext traffic permitted (base-config)
findings.evidence: <base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"> in the network security config — cleartext is allowed for every host by default.
findings.fix: Set cleartextTrafficPermitted=false in <base-config>, or remove the attribute.

findings.title: Cleartext traffic permitted (domain-config for api.example.com)
findings.evidence: <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"> in the network security config.
findings.fix: Set cleartextTrafficPermitted=false for the domain, or serve it over HTTPS.

findings.title: User certificates trusted
findings.evidence: <certificates src="user"> in the network security config — certificates the user installed (for example a proxy CA) are trusted, so traffic can be intercepted.
findings.fix: Trust only system certificates (src="system"), unless user CAs are a deliberate debugging choice.

findings.title: usesCleartextTraffic=true
findings.evidence: android:usesCleartextTraffic=true in <application> — the app opts into cleartext traffic.
findings.fix: Set android:usesCleartextTraffic=false.
